seasons.title: Seasons
seasons.new_subtitle: Pick a crop, your acreage, and a planting date. Panda will generate the activity timeline + scaled input list automatically.
seasons.could_not_load: Could not load seasons. Try again later.
seasons.none_yet: No seasons yet. Plan your first one.
seasons.yield_trajectory_subtitle: Total kg picked across the season. A flat line means harvesting paused; a rising line means you're back in the field.
seasons.inputs_explainer: Quantities scaled to your acreage. Tick off as you procure.
seasons.cost_revenue_chart_subtitle: Where the lender-grade PDF gets its profit number from.
seasons.delete_cost_body: Removes this cost entry from the season. The total spent + cost-by-category chart update immediately. Soft-deleted — recoverable by an admin within 30 days.
seasons.delete_harvest_body: Removes this harvest pick from the season. Picked / sold / revenue totals update immediately. Soft-deleted — recoverable by an admin within 30 days.
seasons.abandon_body: Marks the season as abandoned (status → abandoned). The data stays intact for record-keeping; you'll see it in the list with an 'abandoned' badge but no new activities will be generated. Use this when a planting failed before harvest. To completely undo a mistaken season, contact support.

onboarding.welcome_subtitle: Three things to know before you start.
onboarding.step1_body: A season = one crop on a known acreage. Panda generates the activity timeline + scaled input list for you. You can run several seasons at once (e.g. tomato in one plot, kale in another).
onboarding.step2_title: 2. Log activities as you do them.
onboarding.step2_body: Tap “Mark done” when you finish a step. Log every cost (seed, fertiliser, labour) and every harvest pick + sale. Lender-grade reports come out of this data.
onboarding.step3_body: Forms save offline and sync when you’re back online. The PDF report you can download is what banks ask for when scoring you for a loan.

help.acreage_body: Total area you’ll plant for this season, in acres. Panda scales the input list (seeds, fertiliser, pesticide) to match. Roughly 1 acre = 0.4 ha. Use a decimal for fractions (e.g. 0.5).
help.irrigation_body: How the crop will be watered. Greenhouse boosts yield by ~30% and cuts pesticide need; drip is mid-tier; rainfed is cheapest but most weather-exposed. The choice changes the timeline + spray schedule.
help.planting_date_body: When the seedlings/seed went into the ground. Panda counts every activity from this date — so be accurate. You can change it later if needed.
help.cost_amount_body: Total Kenyan Shillings spent on this line. Tax-inclusive if you paid VAT. If a single receipt covers multiple items, log them as separate cost entries so the category breakdown is honest.
help.harvest_picked_body: Total kilogrammes you harvested in this pick — include unsold + spoilage. “Sold” (next field) is what actually left the farm.
help.harvest_price_body: What the buyer paid you per kilogramme. Use the actual price, not the market rate — brokers often pay below market. Panda compares your price against the local benchmark.
help.summary_cost_body: Sum of every cost entry you've logged in this season — seed, fertiliser, sprays, labour, equipment, transport. Doesn't include land rent or your own time (those are usually treated as fixed costs at the farm level, not the season level).
help.summary_revenue_body: Σ (sold_kg × price_per_kg) for every harvest pick logged. Excludes unsold or spoiled kilos — you only count what actually left the farm at a paid price.
help.summary_profit_body: Revenue − Total cost. Green if positive, red if negative. This is the same number that appears on the lender PDF report — banks and SACCOs use it to score loan applications. If the season isn't finished yet, the profit number is still preliminary.
